title: Vendor panel (Seller Center): growth, finance, FBN and account — browser test report
summary: Playwright browser test of Seller Center growth, finance, fulfilment and account pages: coupons and the D10 limits (90%, 365 days, 20 live), a flash-sale offer, a marketer campaign, a sponsored product campaign and a paid placement, earnings/statements/payouts, a subscription paid through the fake card gateway (declined then captured, PDF, auto-renew with the saved card, plan change, cancel and keep), Fulfilled by Nawy end to end (enrol, 0 fees, inbound plan draft → submit → carton labels HTML/PDF → shipped → received, removal and cancel), packaging supplies, team with a limited role and a full password reset, documents, store settings, contracts, support, notifications, Arabic RTL and 2FA sign-in. Re-run of 2026-11-19 after the big development catalogue (5,000 products, about 30,000 offers and 60 sellers per country, new home and category pages, mega menu): the full Playwright suite ran on a fresh production build with E2eSeeder records; 16 of 16 flows passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped.

Laravel dev DB (uae; Qatar for the Seller Agreement gate), MAIL_MAILER=log, NAWY_PAYMENTS_DRIVER=fake

issues.description: VEN-36 failed on console errors: two 429 answers of the shared per-IP two-factor limit (6 a minute, every e2e browser is 127.0.0.1) that panelSignIn() waits out and retries.
issues.fix: VEN-36 drops only those retried 429s of the panel login / two-factor URLs (dropRetriedSignIn429 in support/vendor.ts) before checking the console.

issues.description: Money fields rendered as type="number" without step accept whole numbers only, so the browser blocked a CPC bid of 0.75 or a daily budget of 25.5. Same defect on Travel Partner room price per person, Open Souq 'mark as sold' final price (an ad priced 1000.5 could not be marked sold), broker lead budget and admin coupon-participation minimum fee.
issues.fix: step="any" min="0" on those inputs. Pest: PanelMoneyInputsTest scans every panel view for money number fields without a step.

issues.description: A campaign 'Pending review' showed a 'Resume' button; clicking it took the campaign live without Nawy's ad review (the state machine allows pending_review → active for the admin decision).
issues.fix: SellerAdvertisingController only moves active/paused/budget-exhausted campaigns (SELLER_MOVABLE) and the view only offers buttons for those. Pest: VerticalPanelsTest 'creates a sponsored campaign for review…'.

issues.description: The seller's subscription history said 'Times in Oman' and showed Oman time (the shared admin partial) on a UAE store.
issues.fix: The transitions partial takes an optional timezone; Seller Center passes the country's. Pest: VendorSubscriptionsTest (first test).

issues.description: Back from the card gateway the seller landed on Subscription with no message at all; after a declined card nothing said the payment failed (the ?payment=&status= the return URL adds was ignored).
issues.fix: SellerSubscriptionController::show reads the store's own payment by reference and shows 'Invoice paid.', the decline message, or 'not confirmed yet'. Pest: VendorSubscriptionsTest 'tells the store how the card payment ended…'.

issues.description: The offered-fee input was prefilled with the raw '10.0000'.
The gateway result banner stays on later actions of the same visit because ?payment= stays in the URL that back() returns to.

notes: Re-run of 2026-11-19: results, steps and screenshots are from the full Playwright run after the big catalogue (servers on a fresh production build). Issues BR-xx were found and fixed in this run; older issues are kept for reference.

Dev-only: uploaded images are served from APP_URL (http://localhost:8000/storage/…) while the panel CSP allows img-src 'self' https:, so product images do not render on partner.nawy.test:8000 in dev. On the https production hosts they load; the specs drop exactly that console line (dropDevImageCsp).

Panel sign-in is rate-limited per IP (30/min) and per account (30/hour); every agent's browser is 127.0.0.1, so the specs keep one e2e-seller session per worker in the OS temp dir (the shared e2e/.auth files are never rewritten) and serialise sign-ins of one email (two parallel 2FA logins read each other's mail code).
Panel language is saved on the user (preferred_locale), so the Arabic test runs as the run's own store owner, never the shared e2e seller.

Test data per run (support/setup.php, test values only): two new catalogue variants and an FBN variant of the first active product, sub-orders on the e2e store's own variant E2E-VEN-ORD (never listing 19 or the seeded e2e orders), a COD cash record for the delivered ones, a published review and an approved question, a return, a new uae store, a Qatar store, a Seller Agreement template published for Qatar only, a test ad slot (placement e2e_test, never requested by the storefront) and an 'E2E vendor flash sale' open for submissions.

The warehouse receiving of the inbound plan (arrive → receive 6 → finish) is a warehouse-staff step and was run through the InboundShipments service in tinker, so the removal flow had units to remove.

Order labels: the seller moved the COD order to Shipped (confirmed → processing → packed → shipped). No carrier shipment is allocated by that path, so the parcel label button did not show; the invoice PDF is only issued once the order is invoiced (after delivery for COD). Packing slip HTML was checked. Carrier label / delivery are covered in the order-lifecycle report.
FBN fees: the fee preview shows 0 per unit (owner decision).
Coupon limits D10 checked on a brand-new store: 91% refused, an end date more than 365 days away refused, the 20th live coupon accepted and the 21st refused (coupons 2–19 were copies made in tinker).
